# Children's Dentistry of Abilene

> A pediatric dental practice in Abilene, TX specializing in comprehensive children's dental care with a focus on prevention, emergency treatment, and patient comfort.

Children's Dentistry of Abilene is led by Dr. Norm Poorman and Dr. Marites Del Mundo, offering a full range of pediatric dental services from routine checkups to emergency care and specialized treatments. The practice emphasizes holistic approaches, modern technology, and creating positive dental experiences for children.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Children's Dental Care
- Cavity Prevention
- Emergency Dental Care
- Baby Teeth Care
- First Dental Visit
- Dental Anxiety
- Sedation Dentistry
- Dental Restorations
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Digital X-rays
- Fluoride Treatment
- Dental Sealants
- Trauma Dentistry
- Holistic Dental Care

## Core Services & Treatments

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/pediatric-dentistry): Main pediatric dentistry service page with early care and prevention focus
- [Pediatric Dentistry Treatments](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/pediatric-dentistry-treamtments): Overview of pediatric dental treatments and services offered
- [Dental Restorations](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/dental-restorations): Dental restoration services including fillings and crowns for children
- [Dental Extractions](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/dental-extractions): Gentle pediatric tooth extraction and post-extraction care services
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/fluoride): Fluoride treatment options for cavity prevention and enamel protection
- [Dental Sealants](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/sealants): Dental sealant treatments for cavity prevention in children

## Emergency & Specialized Care

- [Pediatric Dental Emergency](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/pediatric-dental-emergency): Emergency pediatric dental care and urgent treatment services
- [Emergency Pediatric Dental Care](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/trauma-dentistry): Specialized trauma dentistry for dental injuries and tooth fractures
- [Sedation Dentistry for Kids](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/sedation-dentistry): Comprehensive sedation options including IV and nitrous oxide for anxious children
- [Nitrous Oxide](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/nitrous-oxide): Nitrous oxide sedation for anxiety relief during pediatric dental visits

## Advanced Technology & Approaches

- [Digital X-rays](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/digital-x-rays): Digital X-ray technology for safe, accurate pediatric dental imaging
- [Holistic Children's Dental Care](https://www.childrensdentistryofabilene.com/abilene-tx/holistic-approach): Holistic dental care options including fluoride-free and low-radiation treatments
